primary.method: exact conditional paired test (binomial on the discordant scenes), one-sided; H_mem by intersection-union over the two policies; Holm over the two hypotheses

H_gen.statement: with train seed 2, VISION_CENTER_V2 succeeds in more scenes than C0

H_mem.statement: with each of the two policies, VISION_CENTER_V2 succeeds in more scenes than V2_SINGLE_FRAME

between_policies.note: two policy seeds give one degree of freedom for a between-seed variance: a range is reported, not a variance estimate

scope: Development data. Not calibration, not Test. The primary tests were fixed before the run; everything else is descriptive.
One task, two policy seeds trained on the same demonstrations, one noise repeat, simulator images.
The safety criteria are development criteria for going on; they do not certify a harm rate.
V2_RULES_OFF measures a bundle of rules, not any single rule.
